hints: Compare the privileged executables you find with the ordinary utilities around them; one has an unexpected relationship to the build workflow.
Pay attention to how a privileged program locates the helper command it launches, and consider what influences command lookup.
Put your own executable with the expected helper name in a directory you control, place that directory first in PATH, then rerun the privileged program. Have your helper establish root access.
